title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: In the lanthanide–nickel–iminodiacetate system, changing the starting lanthanide or reagent ratio can substantially alter cluster nuclearity and shell topology.
explanation: The La/Ni/IDA hydrothermal system yields a La20@Ni30 double shell, while increased La loading gives a connected three-dimensional assembly; Pr or Nd starting salts give Ln20@Ni21 cores, and Gd under otherwise identical conditions yields a 108-metal, four-shell cluster.
scope: The reviewed aqueous lanthanide nitrate, nickel nitrate, and iminodiacetic acid cluster syntheses.
conditions: Hydrothermal synthesis for the La20@Ni30 example; changes in starting Ln/Ni/IDA ratio or lanthanide identity as described in Section 3.2.
caveats: These outcomes are system-specific and do not establish a predictive rule for other metal–ligand combinations. Some resulting multishell products fall outside the review's definition of fullerene-like clusters.
